About Metabolic 40+

Evidence-based health content for adults over 40. We combine nutritional science, sleep research, and AI-powered content creation to help you thrive in your 40s, 50s, and beyond.

Our Mission

We believe that the second half of life can be the most vibrant. Our content is designed to help you navigate the metabolic changes that begin after 40 with science-backed strategies, honest product reviews, and practical daily habits you can start implementing today.

Editorial Team

The Metabolic 40+ editorial team combines expertise in nutritional science, sleep physiology, exercise science, and AI-augmented content creation. Every article goes through a multi-step review process that includes:

  • Research from peer-reviewed scientific literature
  • Cross-referencing of clinical trial data
  • Review of safety and quality standards for any products mentioned
  • Plain-language editing for accessibility
  • Fact-checking and medical disclaimer verification
